name: Tutor coached course for BB
description: Adds the Tutor BB plugin to the bb Feature's standalone server: a course rail, lesson pages and a coach that works one Gherkin Rule at a time. Requires the bb Feature in standalone mode.

course.description: Absolute path of the course checkout the plugin reads.

courseRepo.description: HTTPS Git URL cloned into 'course' after the container is created, if 'course' does not exist yet. Empty never clones.

factory.description: Optional absolute path of the student's factory repository. When it exists it is registered as a BB project, and the plugin pre-selects it.

selectRail.description: Select the Tutor course rail as BB's sidebar thread list once, unless another thread list was chosen already.
